newsitem.title: TAIWAN: CMC Magnetics gets US$20 mln U.S. orders.
newsitem.headline: CMC Magnetics gets US$20 mln U.S. orders.

text.p: Taiwan's CMC Magnetics Corp said on Thursday it had received videotape orders worth about US$20 million from the United States for 1997.
"The order totals some US$20 million. It's a big order for the company and will certainly boost our performance next year," a CMC spokeswoman said by telephone.
CMC is one of the island's leading videotape and computer disk makers.
CMC predicted big leaps in profits and sales for 1997.
The firm forecast 1997 profit at T$1 billion on turnover of T$4.4 billion, compared with a 1996 profit projection of T$450 million on turnover of T$2.7 to 3.0 billion, the spokeswoman said.
